## Auto Apply Stub

This sub-workflow is intentionally a placeholder.

When you enable `AUTO_APPLY_ENABLED=true`, qualified jobs (score ≥ 70) are routed here.

**Next steps to implement:**
1. Add Switch node on `job.source`
2. Greenhouse → HTTP form submit or browser automation
3. Lever → Lever apply API / form POST
4. Ashby → Ashby application endpoint
5. Log results back to Google Sheets `ApplicationStatus` column
6. Never auto-apply to sources without explicit user authorization
